siteAddress: 35-39 William Street, Shop 35 MarketPlace Raymond Terrace, NSW 2324
issue: TSAURAYTREIPR01 TSN FRE Offline PC — Back to Back solution
brief:
SOLUTION TYPE: Back to Back

NOTE: Tech to bring step ladder and screwdriver for enclosure.

TECH MUST BRING (IMPORTANT)
- Wired Keyboard, Mouse and Laptop
- Ethernet cables and HDMI cables
- Power tester
- Universal TV remote control
- Labeler or masking tape and marker

IMPERATIVE: The TECHNICIAN MUST call Support at 1300-203-810 (Option 1) upon arrival to provide the CHECK-IN TIME and again before leaving to provide the CHECK-OUT TIME, which requires confirmation from the Manager or Onsite Staff for documentation.

NO REBOOT FOR ROUTER AND SWITCH, unless specifically instructed by Telstra Networks and Infrastructure Lead.
Engagis Support are ONLY ALLOWED to reboot the Engagis PCs ONLY.
NO equipment is to be connected to ANY device in the LAN rack — either as part of project works or troubleshooting — without approval.
Always request a photo of the comms rack from the store and from all tech visits.

JOB REQUIRED:
- Tech to check power status of both back-to-back shopfront screens.
- Tech to verify both screens are set to the correct input/source.
- Tech to check and reseat HDMI, LAN, and power cable connections.
- Tech to reboot the media player if required.
- Tech to confirm display output on both screens.
- Tech to isolate if the issue is with the screen, media player, cabling, or network.
- Tech to verify content is displaying correctly on both screens.
- Tech to take photos and call Support before leaving site.

REQUIRED (to be filled in on the SOW):
- SCREEN HEALTH CHECK on all solutions. If dents, cracks or LED discolouration are noticed, take a clear photo.
- LED Brightness: ensure brightness levels are consistent and adjustable without flickering or dim spots.
- Signed SOW + photos MUST be sent to installations@engagis.com within 24 hours of job completion.

INVOICING: cross-reference PO90548. No change to total -> accounts.payable@engagis.com. Change to total -> installations@engagis.com.
